purpose: Synthetic mixed physical/virtual/sparable maps exercise a large intermediate but valid bounded final address. The parser must return the exact payload without overflowing.
source: libmkiso 0.1.5 published MIT-licensed UDF fixture helpers, with a focused Tonalli arithmetic-boundary regression
note: The authored fixture omits VRS, so the core regression invokes the public UdfReader directly as well as the Tonalli facade to exercise the vulnerable mapping branch. It is not a valid producer-conformance fixture.
